method: Sequential baseline then candidate on the same host; in-memory AppNotifier and full SwarmScreen native toolbar construction. Headless debug elapsed notification + microtask turn; no Flutter frame is pumped during the timed turn. Seven rounds, median per turn. No owned build, profiler or other test ran concurrently. Uncontrolled unrelated host activity remains possible.
scope: Full native toolbar construction with unchanged inventory notifications; excludes Flutter frames, AppKit, transport, agents and whole-app energy.
